root.name: Slav Defense: Alapin Variation
root.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. c4 c6 3. Nf3 Nf6 4. Nc3 dxc4 5. a4

overview: In the Slav Two Knights Attack White plays 5.a4 after ...dxc4 to stop ...b5 and keep control of c4 and e5. Black develops the bishop with ...Bf5 and plays ...e6, ...Bb4, castles and often ...Nbd7. White regains the pawn with e3 and Bxc4, then e4 for a big centre.

white_ideas.idea: Regain the pawn with e3 and Bxc4
Play e4 or the Ne5 outpost

typical_structures.structure: Slav structure with White centre and Black hold on c4 gone

character.notes: Solid Slav lines; Black is hard to break down.

structure.notes: Slav pawn structure leaves a half-open file.
